_notes: SessionEnd hook. Never writes stdout and always exits 0 — the ONLY observable behavior is the
filesystem effect on the pending-patterns.json file, so every case here is kind 'effect' or
'allow'. The source has no deny path (no deny(...) / "deny" anywhere), so no deny case exists.
HOME is set to '.' in every case on purpose: get_pending_file() resolves under Path.home(), which
is outside the harness sandbox by default and would make the write invisible to the fs-delta
comparison. HOME='.' makes Path.home() relative, so the write lands inside the sandbox cwd and is
actually pinned. A port that resolves home differently (e.g. os.homedir() ignoring HOME) fails here.
transcript_path is likewise relative so it resolves against the sandbox cwd.
